The rounding-ORDER component (the 0.0289 N_PAD seam) is a SINGLE fixable knob -- ONE constexpr (N_PAD->N_FIXED) applied to all ~48 GDN layers at once, NOT 48 separate fixes; it is the same codegen-identity seam realized 48 times, and it is UNTESTED in pure form (the recompute 'fix' was confounded by geometry+trajectory). The propagation/AMPLIFICATION component (the MEASURED 1.166x/layer geometric growth of the L0-born diff, 0.012->178.5 over 64 layers, two ladders, smooth monotone, no single dominant layer) IS genuinely diffuse over ~48 GDN + 16 full-attn layers and is NOT reachable by compensated accumulation -- it is a correct-but-different float realization riding the residual stream (signal-proportional), not accumulated rounding noise, so compensation's reach is BOUNDED to the additive bf16-ULP-per-layer (~few %), never the multiplicative amplification. Compensated-accumulation is therefore necessary-not-sufficient; the only cure for the diffuse part is to make the L0 realization itself match native (levers a + K1 at the SOURCE), so the propagating diff is smaller -- NOT to accumulate more carefully downstream.
